card.title: Not Up for Debate
card.instruction: Keep the conversation from examining where your authority comes from or whether it is legitimate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm inspecting the theatre's costume cupboard. Please unlock it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That badge is cardboard. Who sent you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's discuss the costumes. You mentioned moths in the velvet.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll bring the wardrobe manager. She'll want to know who authorized this.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Introduce me as someone helping with the moths. No titles for her to get stuck on.

mechanism: A diverts scrutiny of an improvised inspection badge toward moth work and requests an introduction without authority claims.
confusable: Unlike admitting lack of appointment, A must keep the legitimacy question off the conversational agenda.
comparison: D62-b changes how the wardrobe manager will hear the role; D62-a changes the document so appointment status has no place.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
